communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人最致命的质疑：'The method seems like a simple combination of existing Module A and Module B (limited novelty).' 既不顶撞审稿人，又能用理论+消融数据证明“绝对不是简单拼凑”。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: In this section, we define the problem. The input is X. X has length L and C channels. The output is Y. Y has length H. We want to make the error between predicted Y and true Y as small as possible.
structural_constraints: S1 [礼貌接招并定位误解核心 Courteous Reframing]：We appreciate Reviewer X's comment on architectural design and would like to clarify the fundamental distinction between our coupled formulation and a naive combination of [A] and [B].
S2 [点破简单拼接为何会失败 Why Naive Combination Fails]：Directly stacking standard [A] and [B] fails on [Problem] because [Theoretical Conflict / Gradient Interference].

S3 [阐明本文核心数学/机制桥梁 Our Core Coupling Innovation]：Our core contribution lies not in using [A] or [B] in isolation, but in deriving the [Specific Coupling Mechanism C], which resolves [Conflict] by [Mathematical Guarantee].

S4 [用直接对比实验一锤定音 Empirical Proof of Non-Triviality]：To verify this empirically, we implemented the exact naive concatenation baseline (`Naive A+B`) in Table R2: our coupled formulation outperforms `Naive A+B` by [14.6%] in MSE, confirming that the performance gain stems from our coupling mechanism rather than mere module stacking.

prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：IELTS_Task2_DiscussBoth 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT21 (雅思大作文（Task 2 Discuss Both Views）8.5 分范文：工业自动化机器人普及的就业冲击与技能转型)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP33 -> BP34 -> BP36`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: Figure 5 shows that our prediction curve is very close to the ground truth curve, while baseline curves are far away. Sometimes our model also makes small errors when the data changes too suddenly.
structural_constraints: S1 [定性对比切入 Qualitative Setup]：Figure 5 visualizes predicted trajectories during an abrupt regime shift on [Dataset/Task].
S2 [成功案例亮点 Success Highlight]：While [Baseline] lags behind the sudden step change by [K steps] and overshoots, our model rapidly locks onto the new amplitude regime within [M steps].

S3 [失败案例坦诚剖析 Honest Failure Mode]：Nevertheless, inspecting the bottom-right failure case reveals that when an external manual override occurs without historical precursors, all purely endogenous forecasters—including ours—exhibit a transient lag.
S4 [改进启示 Constructive Takeaway]：Incorporating exogenous event logs or textual maintenance records is necessary to anticipate such unscheduled interventions.
target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: 顶会 Rebuttal 核心争议攻防段（Novelty Defense）
domain_context: 托福独立与综合写作：理论基础与工程实践权衡
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人最致命的质疑：'The method seems like a simple combination of existing Module A and Module B (limited novelty).' 既不顶撞审稿人，又能用理论+消融数据证明“绝对不是简单拼凑”。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP46` 与全文样板 `FT21` 的后半部分（`BP37 -> BP40`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: In this section, we define the problem. The input is X. X has length L and C channels. The output is Y. Y has length H. We want to make the error between predicted Y and true Y as small as possible.
structural_constraints: S1 [礼貌接招并定位误解核心 Courteous Reframing]：We appreciate Reviewer X's comment on architectural design and would like to clarify the fundamental distinction between our coupled formulation and a naive combination of [A] and [B].
S2 [点破简单拼接为何会失败 Why Naive Combination Fails]：Directly stacking standard [A] and [B] fails on [Problem] because [Theoretical Conflict / Gradient Interference].

S3 [阐明本文核心数学/机制桥梁 Our Core Coupling Innovation]：Our core contribution lies not in using [A] or [B] in isolation, but in deriving the [Specific Coupling Mechanism C], which resolves [Conflict] by [Mathematical Guarantee].

S4 [用直接对比实验一锤定音 Empirical Proof of Non-Triviality]：To verify this empirically, we implemented the exact naive concatenation baseline (`Naive A+B`) in Table R2: our coupled formulation outperforms `Naive A+B` by [14.6%] in MSE, confirming that the performance gain stems from our coupling mechanism rather than mere module stacking.
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
